key_facts: The company raised its full year revenue guidance and adjusted earnings per share guidance for the remainder of 2021.
The company's third quarter revenue increased by 18.6% year-over-year, with nine months ended September 30 revenue up by 14.5% year-over-year.
Same unit revenue for the third quarter grew by 8.3% compared with last year, and for the nine months, same unit revenue grew by 7.3% compared with last year.
The Financial Services group's total revenue grew by 20.4% in the third quarter and by 16% for the nine months ended September 30.
The benefits and insurance group's total revenue grew by 16.1% in the third quarter and by 12.4% for the nine months ended September 30.
The company's adjusted earnings per share for the nine months was $1.84, up 30.5% from $1.41 a year earlier.
The company's income before tax margin declined in the third quarter from 11.4% to 10.3% due to higher expenses, but improved by 120 basis points to 15.2% for the nine months.
The company closed five acquisition transactions that will contribute approximately $72 million of annualized revenue.

The company has used $74.8 million for acquisition purposes through September 30, with future earn-out payments estimated at approximately $6.6 million for the balance of 2021, $26.7 million in 2022, $19.3 million in 2023, $22.9 million in 2024, and approximately $6 million in 2025.

The company repurchased approximately 2.7 million shares through September 30, with an additional 258,000 shares repurchased through October 26, leading to an expected full year share count within a range of 53.5 million to 54 million shares.
The company's debt outstanding on its unsecured $400 million credit line was $190.2 million at September 30, with $201.6 million of unused capacity.
Adjusted EBITDA for the nine months this year was $153.5 million, up 21% from $126.9 million a year ago.
The company's day sales outstanding on receivables was 88 days at September 30, reflecting improvements over the past 12 to 18 months.
Bad debt expense through September 30 this year was approximately 10 basis points of revenue compared with 41 basis points a year ago.
The company's effective tax rate for the nine months was approximately 24.5%, with a full year effective tax rate expected within a range of 24% to 24.5%.
The company expects total revenue growth in 2021 within a range of 12% to 15% over 2020.
Adjusted earnings-per-share growth is expected within a range of 20% to 24% over the $1.42 earnings per share recorded in 2020.
The company completed the acquisition of Shea Labagh Dobberstein, an accounting, tax, and advisory services firm based in San Francisco, Bay Area, in early September.
The acquisition of Shea Labagh Dobberstein is part of the company's long-term growth strategy on the West Coast and complements its existing geographic footprint.
The company's full year outlook includes a projected slight operating loss in newly acquired operations in the fourth quarter due to typical seasonality of these businesses.
The company's vacation expense accruals followed a more normal pattern this year, resulting in no significant favorable adjustment projected in the fourth quarter compared to last year.
